screens.name: Signup
screens.derivationNotes: Same two-column gradient layout with First Name, Last Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password. Heading 'Create your account'. Button 'Start listening'. Bottom link 'Already listening? Sign in'.

screens.name: ForgotPassword
screens.derivationNotes: Same layout with only Email field. Heading 'Reset your password'. Button 'Send reset link'. Bottom link 'Back to sign in'.

screens.name: ResetPassword
screens.derivationNotes: Same layout with New Password and Confirm Password. Heading 'Set new password'. Button 'Reset password'.

screens.name: Library
screens.derivationNotes: Same sidebar and mini-player layout. Header 'Your library' with tabs (Shows, Episodes, Downloaded, Favorites). 4-column grid of 8 subscribed show cards (120px cover, title in Sora, host, orange new episode count pill, unsubscribe menu). Below: 'Recently saved episodes' list with 6 rows (thumbnail, title, show, duration mono, date). Persistent mini-player at bottom.

screens.name: Queue
screens.derivationNotes: Sidebar with Queue active. Header 'Playback queue' Sora + '8 episodes · Total 5h 32m' mono. Right: 'Clear queue' + 'Shuffle' ghost buttons. Now playing card (100px cover, title, show, waveform bar with mono times '15:42 / 42:18'). 'Up next' reorderable list with 7 episode rows each with drag handle, 64px cover, title Sora 600, show, mono duration, X remove, 'in 47 min' mono.

screens.name: Settings
screens.derivationNotes: Two-pane Settings. Left nav 220px (Playback active, Downloads, Notifications, Profile, Premium, Connected services, Privacy, About). Right cards: Playback card (default speed slider mono '1.0x', skip forward/back selectors, Auto-play toggle, Sleep timer dropdown, Crossfade toggle). Audio quality card (Stream radio High/Medium/Low with kbps mono, Download radio). Bluetooth controls toggles. Save bar bottom with Cancel ghost + 'Save changes' orange primary.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.derivationNotes: Same 260px left sidebar (Notifications nav active with primary 10% bg) and 88px persistent dark player bar. Top bar (56px) has Wavelength logo, search input, bell icon active with primary dot, avatar. Main content centered max 800px: Section heading 'Notifications' Sora 800 24px with right-aligned 'Mark all as read' ghost button + filter dropdown. Filter pill chips below: All (active primary), New episodes (with green '12' badge), Recommendations (3), Announcements (2). Vertically stacked notification rows grouped under uppercase section labels (Today, Yesterday, This week — Inter xs 600 tracking wide tertiary). Each row: Surface bg, 88px height, 12px radius, 16px padding, 1px border-primary, layout [56px show art][1fr title + body][duration mono + time-ago mono + 40px play primary circle]. Unread rows have a 3px primary left border accent and elevated shadow, read rows flat. Mix examples: 'Crime Junkie just released a new episode — The Vanishing of Marie' with green NEW pill and '23 min ago', 'Recommended for you — Heavyweight' with subscribe + button, 'Reply All posted an announcement — We are returning for season 12 in May 2h ago', 'You have 3 new episodes from Radiolab', 'Serial Season 5 is now available', 'Your weekly digest is ready'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.derivationNotes: Same 260px left sidebar (Profile nav active) and 88px persistent dark player bar. Top: hero header with 120px circular avatar (warm gradient placeholder), display name 'Alex Morgan' Sora 800 32px, '@alexlistens' Inter mono secondary, member-since mono 'Listening since Mar 2024', followed by Edit profile ghost button + Share profile button (orange primary). Stats row (4 stat cards in a single row): 'Total listening time' value 'Sora 800 42px' showing '247h 12m' mono, 'Episodes played 1,284', 'Shows subscribed 47', 'Favorites 89' — each card Surface bg, 12px radius, 24px padding, 1px border. Tabs: Subscriptions (active), Listening history, Favorites, Playlists. Active tab shows 4-column grid of 8 subscribed show cards (1:1 cover 200px, Sora title, host secondary, last-updated mono 'Updated 2d ago', orange unplayed badge if any). Below: 'Currently listening' card — single horizontal row with 80px cover, episode title, show, mono progress '12:34 / 45:08' with progress bar, mono '23% complete', resume play button. Keep warm off-white background, orange accent, mono for all stats and durations.
